title: The koi mosaic courtyard
alt: A koi mosaic fills the centre of a sunlit arched courtyard.
description: Flat mosaic fish, intricate tile surfaces and a richly detailed architectural setting.
prompt: A sophisticated architectural photograph of a sunlit courtyard whose entire floor is an intricate mosaic depicting orange koi among blue-green water lilies. The mosaic fish remain flat tiles, not living animals. Tall white plaster arches, a shaded carved wooden bench and leafy potted plants surround the artwork. Fine tesserae and grout visible, a complete central fish motif, deep shadows, balanced warm white and aquatic blue, no people or writing.
